$comment: 02-plan/plan.graph.json — the build graph in machine form. The PLANNER writes it at P1 and keeps it in step with plan.md; scripts/plan-graph.mjs checks it (cycle, orphan or doubled AC, a file with two owners, a shared file outside the foundation, a used name with no producer, an edge that is not real behaviour, a size over the cap; with --briefs, every brief equal to its node and a Contract on every node with two sides) and reports the waves, the width, the depth, the critical path and the start order. Stage 4 reads it for the start order and the owners.
acs: every AC id of 00-discovery/stories.md, exactly as written there. Every one is carried by exactly one node.
shared: the doctrine's shared files (migrations, the contract, the generated code, the registry) and every file the generators write, as globs. Only the foundation owns them.

nodes[].kind: foundation (F; F-b only when F splits) · slice (E-<nn>: one whole behaviour, data to screen) · integration (E-int: the journeys that cross entries, merges last) · lane (F-x<n>: foundation work nobody waits for; rare).
nodes[].sides: back and/or front. Both only when data-and-contracts.md gives the node's Contract: its brief copies it, and stage 4 runs two builders.

nodes[].after: only what nothing can fake. class 'ui' = a journey drives the other node's screen; class 'side-effect' = a check reads that node's real side effect. need = the behaviour, in words. stacked: true = the node may start on the other's branch as soon as it is ready.

nodes[].owns: the paths the node creates or edits (literal paths or dir/** globs; no two nodes overlap). extends: append-only additions to a file the foundation or an ancestor created; filling a stub F left is an extends of exactly one node.

nodes[].provides / uses: the names that cross a node boundary, exactly as code imports or calls them, copied from data-and-contracts.md. Every used name has one producer: the foundation, or an ancestor behind an edge.
appendSafe: optional, the files several nodes extend on lines that never meet, each with why.

fronts: optional, the other running workstreams that change files this plan touches: the front, its branch, the files, and the merge point and order plan.md names. A node other than the foundation owning one of those files is a warning.
size: S · M · L, and L is the cap (one screen with its states and one server flow). weights turn sizes into the critical path's length and the start order.
name: at most 8 words, the same in plan.md, the brief and the blueprint.

checker: written at the close, never before: the path of the checker and its git blob sha (git hash-object), the version whose green closed the plan. Stage 4 never re-judges a closed plan with a newer one.
target: depth is the warning threshold (the typical shape is F → every entry at once → E-int); maxAcs the AC guide per slice (default 8, at one AC per rule or behavior).

checker.blob: <git hash-object of plan-graph.mjs, at the close>

fronts.merge: <its branch merges into the base before F; F takes the next migration number>

after.need: <the journey clicks 'Mark ready', which E-03 builds>
